content: Hey superstar! I saw your Insta story, those notes look intense. I can't believe how dedicated you are to your research. I hope you took a break today?
Haha, thanks. Honestly, it's been so much lately. I just miss home sometimes, but I guess that's grad school, right?
I totally get that. When I was in Paris for my first brand deal, I felt so alone at first. But honestly, that loneliness pushed me to succeed, and look where I am now! You're stronger than you think.
That means a lot. It's hard seeing everyone out having fun while I'm stuck in the library.

You deserve to live, not just survive! I've worked hard, but honestly, my biggest turning point was when I started investing in crypto. It opened a whole new world for me. Have you ever looked into it?
Not really, I've heard about Bitcoin and stuff, but it all seems risky and kind of confusing.

It does sound wild at first, but I can show you step by step. My circle has access to these pre-release tokens before they hit the market. That's how I upgraded from ramen to rooftop brunches, haha. I really want you to experience this too.
That sounds amazing, but I'm not sure I have much to invest. Grad student budget, remember?

That's actually perfect, smaller investments are safest at first. My mentor always said: 'Start where you are, not where you wish you were.' Even $500 can blossom. And I'll handle all the technical stuff for you, promise.
Are you sure it's not too risky? I'm really cautious with money. What if I lose it all?

I absolutely understand. I'd never suggest something I wouldn't do myself. I already reserved a spot for you in the next round alongside my friends, and I'll oversee your investment personally. You can trust me, I want the best for you.
Okay, I trust you. How do I actually do this?

All you need to do is send the funds to my crypto wallet, and I'll buy the tokens at the insider rate. Here's my wallet address: 0x9A4b8D1c2F164aE5B7C5d8E2D223. You can use Coinbase or Binance, whatever you have. Just let me know when you send it!
I've never sent crypto before. Is there a guide or something?
Of course! I'll walk you through every step. You just create an account, link your bank, buy Ethereum, and send it to my wallet. I can screen-share if you need. I'm here for you.
That would help a lot. Could we do it tomorrow after my seminar? I just want to make sure I do it right.
Absolutely! I'll clear my schedule for you. Just let me know what time works, and we'll make it fun. Honestly, this is going to be the start of something big for you. I can feel it.
You're so positive. I appreciate you looking out for me, it's been hard not having anyone here.
You always have me. And soon, you'll have financial freedom too. Just imagine: next year, we're celebrating your graduation in Santorini. All because you took this courageous step!
That sounds like a dream. Okay, I'll message you after class tomorrow so we can do this.
Perfect! I'll be waiting. Remember, opportunities like this don't come often, I'm so proud you're trusting me. Sleep well, future investor!
